g.text: Every layer of environmental law substitutes a number for an intention. Every substitution opens a gap.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: The gaps have been there for fifty years. What kept them shut was never the drafting.

g.text: Fifty years of regulatory stability rested on the second term, not the first. Reinforcement learning has now rediscovered more than sixty per cent

g.text: of the loopholes that real regulations had to be amended to close—while merely optimising a reward, with no instruction to look for exploits
